title: Splatoon Raiders
description: A single-player-focused Splatoon spin-off where the Mechanic and Deep Cut raid the Spirhalite Islands, fight Salmonids, recover salvage, craft gadgets and upgrade three specialized Tanks. Up to four players can join through online or local wireless co-op.

gameplayPillars.title: Raid for treasure
gameplayPillars.description: Choose destinations, fight Salmonids and bring salvage back to the Hideout Ship.

gameplayPillars.title: Build your loadout
gameplayPillars.description: Upgrade Speed, Power or Tactical Tanks, craft gadgets and hunt weapon variants with different bonuses.

gameplayPillars.title: Bring friends
gameplayPillars.description: Play solo or call in up to three other players online or via local wireless; player power scales to the group.

worldSummary: A storm strands Deep Cut and the Mechanic on the Spirhalite Islands, a varied archipelago of beaches, volcanic terrain, ruins and underground areas occupied by increasingly strange Salmonids and traces of an ancient civilization.

storyChapters.title: Mayday on Spirhalite
storyChapters.body: A strange storm forces Deep Cut's helicopter down on the islands.

storyChapters.title: Splat, loot, upgrade
storyChapters.body: The crew builds a Hideout Ship and begins raiding nearby islands for treasure and a route home.

storyChapters.title: The deeper mystery
storyChapters.body: New biomes, stronger Salmonids and buried ruins point toward an older secret beneath the archipelago.

faq.q: Does it have normal Splatoon competitive multiplayer?
faq.a: The focus is PvE raiding and co-op rather than the traditional competitive Turf War structure.

verdictSummary: A confident Splatoon spin-off that turns the series' movement and shooting into a deep raid-and-upgrade adventure. Its strongest qualities are build variety, excellent controls, strong performance and an unusually substantial post-game.
verdictCons: No traditional competitive Turf War focus
Some repetition is inherent to the raid loop
100% completion requires a long post-game grind
